jobs.title: Security Officer for Northwood Club
jobs.description:
Northwood Club is a prestigious country club established in 1946, we are best known for hosting the 1952 Golf U.S. Open. Our beautifully renovated PGA Championship Golf Course was named #1 Best Golf Course Renovation in Avid Golfer Magazine for 2019. Rated overall best country club in Avid Golfer from 2022 - 2024. Among other awards the club also has a Distinguished Clubs of the World Emerald Designation for outstanding member service. Northwood Club has a family-oriented environment with friendly members, great staff, and an amazing landscape to come to work to every day.

We are currently looking for a full-time security officer to provide and maintain security and safety of people and property of Northwood Club at all times with the ability to enforce Club rules, policies and regulations. You must be able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. Ability to complete or have CPR & First Aid Certification. MUST BE ABLE TO WORK EVENINGS, WEEKENDS AND HOLIDAYS.

Essential Duties:

  • Visual to everyone entering and exiting club property.
  • Verify all incoming traffic, alerting staff of deliveries, guests for dinner, and directing guest and vendors where to park.
  • Properly authenticating members and employees who enter onto property. Documenting guests in the guest log.
  • Patrols property checking for suspicious activity or persons or safety/fire hazards.
  • Investigates and/or reports hazards, unusual or suspicious circumstances to clubhouse manager or general manger for correction of follow-up actions.
  • Observes activity and traffic in assigned area to enforce club rules/regulations; alerts visitors of infractions.
  • Assists any persons on property needing directions or club information.
  • Responds to alarms and dispatched calls; decides what actions to take based on situation, facts known and position limitations.
  • Knows club's emergency response manual, security's role and procedures for all emergency situations as documented.
  • Submit daily incident report at end of each shift.
  • Patrol property with use of golf cart and ensure all facilities are secure.
  • Patrol and secure off site parking lot as needed.
  • Complete opening and closing procedures as trained.
  • Maintains flexibility to take on new and different tasks as directed by the Department Manager/Supervisor.
  • Incorporates safe work practices in job performance.
  • Must be able to operate and drive a golf cart
  • Comply and knows all safety policies of the Club as well as federal laws pertaining to OSHA, and EPA regulations.
  • Attends staff meetings when required

Basic Requirements:

  • Ability to work evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods of time
  • Ability to bend, reach, or lift 20-30 lbs.
  • Ability to operate computers or computerized equipment.
  • Positon requires you to work extended hours outside where you will exposed to various weather conditions.
  • Position requires you to conform to a specifice appearance and dress code. Conduct yourself in a professional manner at all times.

This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Guest Arrival Desk in Plano, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries. As a Front Desk Security Professional with Allied Universal, you will be the welcoming presence at a dynamic technology location, supporting access control, visitor management, and security-related communications. You will provide exceptional customer service, maintain awareness of activity at the front desk, and help address concerns with professionalism. Join a caring, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first, works together, and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $18.50 / Hour

Job Schedule

What You'll Do

  • Monitor entry activity, access-control systems, and communications equipment, reporting unusual conditions or access concerns to appropriate personnel.

jobs.title: Security Officer – Construction Site Post Waxahachie, Texas
jobs.description:
Security Reconnaissance Team, Inc. (C13489) is hiring Non-Commissioned / Level II (Unarmed) Security Officers for multiple sites in the Dallas area.

We are a growing Texas security company that values customer service, reliability, and clear communication. Join a professional team with a variety of shift options available.

This is an unarmed, uniformed position.

Job Duties

  • Monitor all vehicles and personnel entering and exiting the property
  • Secure and lock access points once the last authorized person has left for the evening
  • Reopen access at the end of the shift before leaving the site
  • Conduct patrols every 15 minutes throughout the shift
  • Vary patrol routes and timing to stay unpredictable
  • Stay alert for anything suspicious, unsafe, or unauthorized
  • Complete activity reports every 15 minutes
  • Document security concerns, safety issues, suspicious activity, unauthorized people or vehicles, and any unusual conditions
  • Include photos with every shift report

Requirements (Must Have)

  • Valid Texas Level II Non-Commissioned (Unarmed) Security License
  • Must be at least 21 years old
  • Reliable transportation and a working cell phone
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check
  • Drug-free (we are a Drug-Free Workplace)
  • Eligible to work in the United States

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Bi-weekly pay via direct deposit
  • Uniforms provided
  • Free continued training (state licensing, re-qualification, expandable baton, handcuffing, and OC)
  • Great work atmosphere and advancement opportunities
  • Equal opportunity employer – military veterans are strongly encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person – Waxahachie, Texas

If you meet the requirements and are looking for a reliable security position with flexible full-time or weekend options, apply today. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Pay: $16.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Professional development assistance
  • Referral program
  • Vision insurance

License/Certification:

  • Level II security license (Required)

Work Location: In person
